title: Sonoriferous
summary: SONORIF'EROUS, adjective [Latin sonus, sound and fero, to bring.] That gives sound; sounding; as the sonoriferous particles of bodies.

inlines.v: SONORIF'EROUS, adjective [Latin sonus, sound and fero, to bring.] That gives sound; sounding; as the sonoriferous particles of bodies.
